source.crs: longitude/latitude degrees; datum not declared by publisher

sampling: First 50 parse-valid multi-point rows in original CSV order; no quality ranking; all corpus rows audited.

drawingPolicy.interpretation: Generic visualization integrity filter, not a walking-speed filter or clinical threshold. Preserve points, split segments; never connect across breaks.

limitations: No person identifiers, mood, physiology, home labels, travel-mode labels or repeated daily routines are provided. Each row is an independent generated trajectory.
Publisher claims road-constrained generation; source is not independently clinically validated. Road coordinate datum is unspecified; road-overlay agreement with OSM is not guaranteed.
Coordinate-to-coordinate lines are sampled chords, not full routed geometry. Do not imply walking or map-match silently.

roadIdentifierAudit.warning: Trace road IDs cannot reliably join supplied geometry IDs. No source road geometry is exported; do not infer a map match.

localDatasets.evidence: Actual154-column parquet schema and feature dictionary; no latitude/longitude/GPS fields. Monthly aggregates cannot reconstruct routes.
All7 safely inspected pickle column schemas: Cache has altitude/course/speed/accuracy/time but no lat/lon. META_carrying_location means hand/pocket/rucksack, not a geographic location.
Metadata human-subjects statement explicitly excludes GPS. Raw archive still unavailable; no fabricated file-level inspection.
